name: pii_guard
description: Replaces high-confidence PII and secret patterns in new tool results with recoverable tool errors, without calling a model or network service

permissions.name: ir.tool_results.write
permissions.description: Replace a sensitive tool result with a value-free diagnostic

permissions.name: ir.tool_result_content.write
permissions.description: Collapse structured sensitive output into one safe diagnostic

permissions.name: ir.tool_result_errors.write
permissions.description: Mark a protected tool result as a recoverable tool error

permissions.name: ir.cache_control.write
permissions.description: Preserve and, when visible arms collapse, reposition cache markers around the safe diagnostic

permissions.name: env.state_get
permissions.description: Replay prior replacements across later turns and restarts

permissions.name: env.state_set
permissions.description: Remember replacement decisions without storing sensitive values
